pages.title: Learn
pages.headline: Make sense of digital trust.
pages.excerpt: Explore wallets, credentials and the roles behind them. Follow a knowledge route at your own pace, or bring your team to a guided session.

pages.title: Topics
pages.headline: Choose what you want to understand.
pages.excerpt: Start with the big picture or go straight to a question. There is no required sequence and no account is needed.

pages.title: The big picture
pages.excerpt: Before choosing a wallet or a standard, understand what needs to be trusted — and who can provide the evidence.

pages.title: For businesses
pages.excerpt: Start with a business process: what must your organisation prove, receive or check?

pages.title: How credentials connect issuers, wallets and services
pages.excerpt: A simple example explains the roles: a training provider issues a qualification, its recipient keeps it in a wallet, and an employer checks it.
pages.sources:
FIDES · Verifiable Credentials | https://fides.community/topics/verifiable-credentials/
W3C · Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 | https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model-2.0/
pages.cta_text: Browse use cases, then follow the connections to issuers, wallets and services.

pages.title: European Digital Identity Wallet
pages.headline: European Digital Identity Wallet
pages.excerpt: A way to identify yourself and share verified information when you use a service. What the EUDI Wallet is, who is involved and what it can mean for organisations.

pages.title: EUDI Wallet and European Business Wallet: how do they relate?
pages.excerpt: People and organisations both need to identify themselves and share information. Sometimes they need to do both in the same process.

pages.cta_text: Work through one process with your team in the Wallet Readiness Workshop.

pages.title: What is a credential? And what is an attestation?
pages.excerpt: A credential can help someone provide information that another party can check. In Europe, some digital credentials are described as attestations of attributes.
pages.sources:
W3C · Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 | https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model-2.0/

FIDES · Credential Types | https://fides.community/topics/credentials/
pages.cta_text: Browse the credential types listed in the FIDES Explorer.

pages.title: Issuing credentials for wallets
pages.excerpt: How can your organisation provide information that others can check and use? Start with a purpose, the source of the information and the parties that rely on it.

pages.cta_text: Browse the credential types listed in the FIDES Explorer to see what existing types describe.

pages.title: European Business Wallet
pages.headline: European Business Wallet
pages.excerpt: A European proposal for exchanging business information and acting on behalf of an organisation. What it aims to do, where it stands and how it relates to business wallets in use today.
